blockers.description: Official 2026.3 document bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained.
Generated command-line, MDP, format, and reference pages have not been reproduced from the exact release.
Exact binary help, build features, force-field/data assets, and native execution behavior are not captured by this documentation pack.

limitations: The exact documentation-tree inventory does not establish installed binary identity, build features, force-field provenance, native behavior, sampling convergence, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

binary-help-and-build-closure-missing.description: Exact binary help, build configuration, optional features, regression data, force fields, and native behavior are separate runtime/assets surfaces and remain external.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation bodies remain external.
